The rest of the ring's interior, including its centre, is bare grey knit. The only light comes from outside: pulses of orange pass through the window, strike the plum velvet and the door panel, and bounce up onto the grey wool and the gloved knuckles, so the mask glows warm against the dark car. Through the oval, a taut chain runs back from below the sill to a cast-iron safe skidding along a wet waterfront road, tilted up on one corner and throwing a fan of orange sparks from the corner that touches the ground.
